text:
incident-bot: P1 incident detected for tenant ravenbrook in Dedicated-VPC pool 'db-pool-7'. Elevated 5xx + latency spike on canary slice. Paging SRE oncall.

emily: seeing the alert. errors started ~5m ago, only Ravenbrook tenant affected.

marcela: confirmed from query - error-rate for ravenbrook-prod jumped from 0.4% -> 7.9% around 12:03UTC. CPU on the nodes is normal.

raj: putting this in context: canary rollout of rdb-infer v2.1.4 (quant q8) to ravenbrook started at 11:55UTC. Could be artifact-specific.

ivan: +1 to artifact suspicion. I’ll fetch the canary logs and pinned artifact.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy record: https://console.redwood.local/deploys/9412 commit 3f7a2b9 — artifact rdb-infer:v2.1.4 — applied to tenant ravenbrook (slice ravenbrook-canary).

emily: can we isolate ravenbrook slice so we don't risk side effects to other tenants? Need tenant quarantine and prevent autoscale from touching other pools.

ivan: running tenant quarantine now.

```
# commands
rb tenant quarantine --tenant ravenbrook --pool db-pool-7 --reason "canary 5xx spike"
rb pool lock --pool db-pool-7 --exclude-tenants default,infra
```

ivan: quarantine command returned OK. Slice traffic is now pinned to the canary hosts; other tenants unaffected.

marcela: grabbing sample logs.

```
[2026-03-15T12:03:12Z] req_id=abc123 model=rdb-infer:v2.1.4 kvcache-miss error="out-of-memory: kernel launch failed"
[2026-03-15T12:03:14Z] req_id=abc124 model=rdb-infer:v2.1.4 inference_time=2.6s status=500
```

raj: OOM-ish kernel failures on that build flagged. We should revert the pinned artifact for ravenbrook canary back to v2.1.3 immediately.

emily: does reverting require pool restart or can we pin a different artifact to the tenant slice?

ivan: we can pin per-tenant artifact without a full restart. using pinned-artifact override.

deploy-bot: Artifact available: rdb-infer:v2.1.3 (sha b9c4e6). Previous canary baseline.

raj: Proposed mitigation plan: 1) pin ravenbrook slice to v2.1.3, 2) monitor error-rate and latency, 3) if stable, unquarantine and allow normal routing, 4) open a rollback postmortem and notify CS.

marcela: adding temporary rate limit to protect customer traffic while we revert: `redwood route update --tenant ravenbrook --max-qps 40`.

ivan: executing pin now.

```
rb deploy pin-artifact --tenant ravenbrook --artifact rdb-infer:v2.1.3 --scope slice --force 
# response: pinned artifact updated for ravenbrook-canary -> rdb-infer:v2.1.3
```

emily: applied. waiting for new instances to serve.

marcela: metrics showing initial improvement in tail latency within 60s. error-rate dropping from 7.9% -> 1.2% at +2m.

theo: CSM ping: Ravenbrook support channel notified, CS rep on standby. Asked if we want a joint bridge. Customer replied they can be on a 1pm PT bridge if needed.

ivan: check detailed host logs for any residual errors.

```
# node logs after pin
[12:06:01] model=rdb-infer:v2.1.3 inference_time=0.48s status=200
[12:06:02] model=rdb-infer:v2.1.3 inference_time=0.61s status=200
```

raj: good sign. also verified that only ravenbrook slice saw the v2.1.4 errors (no cross-tenant spillover). Dedicated pool isolation working as intended.

emily: what's the plan for the canary fleet? Do we block v2.1.4 rollout until root cause?

raj: yes. I'll add a global block on v2.1.4 via the model catalog so no other tenants get it.

deploy-bot: Model catalog flag: `v2.1.4` rollout paused by raj at 12:10UTC.

marcela: we should also capture the failing request traces for a follow-up. I’ll create an eval set and tag examples.

ivan: passing to eng-runtime for deeper kernel/OOM analysis. @raj you want to own the RCA?

raj: I’ll take RCA, will need qprofile logs and kernel metrics. tagging runtime team.

emily: handoff: I’m dropping off the active page in 10m — Ivan will own live mitigation and monitoring. Raj will lead RCA. Theo/CS will handle customer comms.

ivan: taking active oncall for the mitigation. I’ll keep the thread updated.

theo: notified customer: sent note that we've pinned artifact and seeing improvement; will update them at 13:00 PT with stability check.

marcela: temporary mitigations implemented: tenant quarantine, artifact pin, qps cap. Tracking dashboard: https://console.redwood.local/dashboards/ravenbrook-canary

ivan: metrics stable at 0.5% error-rate after pin, latency P95 back to baseline. Closing the immediate mitigation.

emily: nice work. Next steps: (1) RCA by raj, (2) full postmortem doc, (3) decision on whether to rebuild v2.1.4 with kernel fix or roll forward with quant changes.

raj: will put an RCA ticket and assign to eng-runtime + infra for kernel/driver triage.

incident-bot: Incident 1973001234 status changed to 'mitigated' at 12:28UTC. Assigned: raj (RCA), ivan (oncall followup).

theo: CS updated Ravenbrook, they acknowledged and appreciated quick action. They asked for a brief postmortem and confirmation before we reattempt v2.1.4.

marcela: noted. creating postmortem doc and will link here when done.

ivan: handing back to baseline oncall in 30m. If anything regresses, reopen page.

emily: react :thumbsup: to confirm closure from SRE.

raj: logging follow-up tasks: RCA ticket #INC-1973, recreate failing workload in staging with v2.1.4 q8 kernels, validate memory usage, add a canary health check to detect kernel-level failures earlier.

marcela: closing thread for now — will attach postmortem and timeline when ready.

incident-bot: Thread archived by system at 12:52UTC."
